workbench_chat_answer_no: Answer button of a yes/no question an agent asks in the chat
workbench_chat_answer_yes: Answer button of a yes/no question an agent asks in the chat
workbench_chat_attach_image: Tooltip of the chat composer's attach button
workbench_chat_compact: Chat bar button that compacts the conversation
workbench_chat_compact_title: Tooltip of the chat bar compact button
workbench_chat_composer_busy_placeholder: Chat composer placeholder while the agent works; key is Esc
workbench_chat_composer_placeholder: Chat composer placeholder when the agent is idle
workbench_chat_context: Chat bar: how much of the model's context window is used (percent is formatted, like 42%)
workbench_chat_images: Chat message suffix: how many images were attached
workbench_chat_raw_protocol: Tooltip of the chat bar button that shows the raw omp protocol
workbench_chat_search_transcript: Placeholder of the chat transcript search field
workbench_chat_starting_omp: Chat transcript header while omp starts
workbench_chat_stop: Tooltip of the chat composer stop button; key is Esc
